That's no big deal.

meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
present есть; у меня есть = I have
future: буду / будешь ... + infinitive

examples.trans: I have a toy car.
Childhood was hard.
You will be asking for forgiveness.

meanings.note: + prepositional (where)
+ accusative (where to)

examples.trans: How is it in Hungary?

meanings.note: the neuter form 'всё' used alone
neuter всё
plural все

examples.trans: Everything's fine.
As you all know...
Share with everyone.

meanings.note: Prefix 'вс-' ('up') marks upward or sudden onset of action (stem 'егда').

examples.trans: She's always like that.
There's always a way out.
She's offended. She's always like that.

встать.gloss: to stand up, to get up

meanings.en: to stand up, to get up (out of bed)
meanings.note: Prefix 'вс-' ('up') marks upward or sudden onset of action (stem 'тать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to stand up, to get up', paired with 'вставать'.

examples.text: Кто первый встал, того и тапки.
examples.trans: First come, first served (whoever got up first gets the slippers).
I got up early today.

examples.text: Юля, встала и пошла мыть посуду!
examples.trans: Yulia, get up and go wash the dishes!

meanings.note: polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)
meanings.note: case forms

examples.trans: As you all know...
Does the governor support you?

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: neuter главное, used as a noun
neuter главное, used as a noun

examples.trans: The main thing is, don't worry.
This is the main street.
The most important thing is the people.

meanings.en: hot (to the touch, of food/drink, not weather)
meanings.note: Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('hot').

examples.trans: Arkasha, here's some hot tea.
Careful, the cup is very hot.

examples.text: Аркаша, держи горячий чай. И бутерброд с вареньем ешь.
examples.trans: Arkasha, here's some hot tea. And eat a jam sandwich.

meanings.note: intransitive

examples.text: Иди к маме, малыш! Не грусти.
examples.trans: Go to your mama, sweetie! Don't be sad.
Don't be sad, everything will be fine.

examples.text: Привет всем! Что вы тут грустите?
examples.trans: Hello everyone! Why are you sad here?

meanings.note: Core Russian part meaning 'even' in everyday speech.

examples.trans: Even a child knows.
Even Mum doesn't know.
Yes! Even a child knows.

meanings.note: Common masculine noun meaning 'friend' in everyday Russian.

examples.trans: This is Vanya, my childhood friend.
He's my friend.

examples.text: Это Паша, мой заместитель. Это Ваня, друг моего детства.
examples.trans: This is Pasha, my deputy. This is Vanya, my childhood friend.

meanings.note: Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('other, another, different').

examples.trans: Could we go somewhere else?
That's a different building.

examples.text: Послушайте, а можно в другое место? Здесь плохо пахнет.
examples.trans: Listen, could we go somewhere else? It smells bad in here.

meanings.note: baking compartment of a stove

examples.text: Представляешь, в духовке забыли! Юль, выйди.
examples.trans: Can you believe it, they forgot it in the oven! Yul, step out.

meanings.note: Common feminine noun meaning 'life' in everyday Russian.

examples.trans: That's life.

meanings.note: emphasis: вот поэтому ты и... = that's exactly why you...

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.

meanings.note: formally admit into a brotherhood or dedicate work

meanings.note: act of losing or state of being lost

принимать.gloss: to receive, to see (visitors); to take

meanings.note: Prefix 'при-' indicates approaching, attachment, or slight degree of action (stem 'нимать'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to receive, to see (visitors); to take', paired with 'принять'.

examples.trans: The mayor isn't seeing anyone today.
The doctor sees patients in the morning.

examples.text: Я ему сказала, что сегодня вы не принимаете.
examples.trans: I told him you're not seeing anyone today.

meanings.note: act of acquiring something or something acquired

examples.trans: Life is full of losses and gains.
The new chef became a valuable acquisition.

examples.text: Жизнь полна разных потерь и приобретений.
examples.trans: Life is full of various losses and gains.

пройти.gloss: to go through, to pass; to come along

meanings.note: about a feeling or pain: потом пройдёт = it'll pass
'Пройдёмте' = let's go, an official's polite order

examples.trans: Come with me.
Go through, please.
Then it passes.

meanings.note: flat metal pan used for baking in an oven

examples.trans: The cook placed the baking sheet into the oven.
The fish was baked on a hot baking tray.

examples.text: Во имя горячей духовки и противня!
examples.trans: In the name of the hot oven and baking tray!

meanings.note: + dat (rejoice at)

meanings.note: interrogative particle expressing doubt

examples.text: А разве это не чистая правда?
examples.trans: And isn't that the pure truth?

examples.text: Нет, это невозможно. Мы из разных управлений.
examples.trans: No, that's impossible. We're from different departments.

meanings.note: + instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми

examples.text: Во имя тяжёлой сковородки и половника!
